name: Wolverine World Wide Inc
business: Designs, sources and sells branded footwear and apparel (Merrell, Saucony, Sweaty Betty, Wolverine, Cat) to retailers, distributors and consumers worldwide.

events.what: No CEO change in window: Christopher Hufnagel became President and CEO when the board terminated Brendan Hoffman (internal promotion; was President of the company)
No CFO change in window: Taryn Miller replaced retiring CFO Michael Stornant 29 months ago
events.from: VP Corporate and Commercial Finance, Corteva; ex Kimberly-Clark

events.what: Two new independent directors added (board size increase); routine refresh

President, Active Group position eliminated (Susie Kuhn departs); follows elimination of President, International Group (effective 2026-03-03). Org simplification, not a CEO/CFO change. No Item 1.01/2.01 8-K 2024-07-01 to 2026-10-02.

next_event.source: No investor day or framework update found in 2025/2026 corpus. CFO Miller (Q4 2024 call, doc 41179): 'too early to provide a date on the mid-teens profit margin aspiration'. Next routine event is the Q3 2026 earnings call (Q3 guide given on doc 139594), date not in corpus.

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Company frames adjusted operating margin: long-term 'mid-teens' aspiration (Feb 2025, no date) and FY2026 guide of about 9.9% (raised from 9.5% in Aug 2026). Consensus is EBITDA; converted using the FY2026 spread between consensus EBITDA margin (11.13%) and the guided adjusted operating margin (9.9%), about 123 bps, held flat. The 12% operating margin target with a 2024 year (2023, prior CFO Stornant, Hufnagel co-stated) was missed and is superseded; caller's '12%' premise is outdated. Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years (52/53 week year ending near December 31).

statements.quote: It's too early to provide a date on the mid-teens profit margin aspiration that we set for our objectives. We are encouraged, as I shared, about the progress in 2024, up 360 basis points, and in 2025, the guide would have another 80, so 440 basis points in two years.
statements.speaker: Taryn Miller
statements.doc_title: WOLVERINE WORLD WIDE INC Q4 2024 Earnings Call

statements.quote: Adjusted operating margin is now expected to be approximately 9.9% compared to our prior outlook of 9.5%, reflecting the higher gross margin and meaningful operating leverage for the year, while also making strategic investments in our brands and key capabilities.
statements.speaker: Taryn Miller
statements.doc_title: WOLVERINE WORLD WIDE INC Q2 2026 Earnings Call

statements.quote: We continue to find opportunity, look for and find opportunities to expand growth and operating margin. We're obviously going to be doing that now in the face of a larger tariff impact. Our value creation model stays intact.
statements.speaker: Taryn Miller
statements.doc_title: WOLVERINE WORLD WIDE INC Q3 2025 Earnings Call

street.gap_assumption: No target year, so compared with the furthest broadly covered year FY2028: consensus EBITDA margin 11.58% less the FY2026 EBITDA-to-adjusted-operating-margin spread (11.13% minus 9.9% guide = 1.23 pts) gives an implied 10.35% operating margin; mid-teens taken as 15.0%. Even consensus FY2030 EBITDA margin is only 12.12%. Uplift assumes FY2028 revenue and a flat spread.

evidence_of_progress.note: Order [Q1 2026, Q2 2026], adjusted operating margin as stated by CFO Taryn Miller (doc 41174 chunk 8; doc 139594 chunk 9, Q2 at 10.0%). Q3 2026 guided 10.4%, up 130 bps. Gross margin guide 46.9% for 2026 despite about 250 bps unmitigated tariff impact. LTM EBITDA margin 10.6% from VA actuals Q2'25 to Q1'26 (Q2'26 not yet in VA actuals).

disqualifier_reason: No catalyst in the 18-month window and none pending: CEO Hufnagel in seat since 2023-08-06 (38 months) and CFO Miller since 2024-05-09 (29 months); own 8-K Item 5.02 query shows only two routine director adds and eliminations of segment president roles; Item 1.01/2.01 returned nothing; no investor day scheduled.
verdict: Not the archetype: a real, undated mid-teens margin aspiration well above consensus with estimates stable, but the turnaround team is 3 years in and no new catalyst exists.
open_questions: Will management put a year on the mid-teens operating margin aspiration (CFO said too early in Feb 2025), for example with 2027 guidance in February 2027?
Does the 2026-09-21 elimination of the Active Group president role signal a broader restructuring or cost program?
How much of 2026 margin progress reverses if IEEPA tariff refunds do not come and Work Group stays flat?
